Great customer service and an excellent selection of cannabis. The shop has a really cool atmosphere, and the wall of bongs is a nice touch. The owner was very personable and made the experience feel welcoming. I’ll definitely be back.

If you’re in Phuket and looking for a place with genuinely good vibes, this is it.

Anna looked after us and honestly she turned our whole day around. We had just arrived in Thailand and were in the worst mood from travel, heat, crowds… the usual chaos when you land somewhere new. Then we walked in here and her energy completely changed everything.

From the moment we stepped in she greeted us with the biggest smile, made us feel welcome instantly and treated us like we’d known her for years. She’s the kind of person who makes you feel comfortable straight away. Super friendly, easy to talk to, and just genuinely cool.

She told us to relax, make ourselves at home, play PlayStation, hang out… which is exactly the kind of energy you want when you’re starting your trip. No pressure, just great vibes and great service.

You can tell she actually cares about people having a good experience, not just making a sale. That kind of attitude is rare and it makes this place stand out.

First stop of our trip and it set the tone for the whole week. We won’t be going anywhere else while we’re here.

Some budtenders sell weed. Don curates experiences. I’ve smoked a lot of joints. These were surgical. His joints are folded like origami- perfect structure, flawless burn- and the vibes went just as deep. Genuine, thoughtful, and wildly talented. You’ll remember this interaction long after the high. This is how budtending should be done.
